subject: Invoice inquiry: reranker embed double-attribution & VAT documentation
messages:
From: Priya Sharma <priya@cobaltai.com>
To: laura.bennett@redwood.com
Cc: billing@cobaltai.com
Date: Tue, 12 Jan 2027 09:14:00 +0000
Subject: Invoice 2026-12 — unexpected reranker/embed charges and VAT reverse-charge evidence
Attachments: COBOLT-usage-export-20261231.csv (csv)

Hi Laura,

We were reviewing our December invoice (INV-2026-12) and noticed an unexpected line item for ~1.2M embed units that Cobalt did not trigger directly. The pattern looks like calls to our reranker service that also surfaced an auxiliary embed call (same request, different model) — it appears those tokens were charged as full embed units in addition to the normal generation charge.

Two asks:
- Can you confirm whether the reranker->embed path is being double-attributed at billing time (i.e., both models billed separately instead of attributing to the parent request)?
- We also need the EU reverse-charge evidence for December usage (VAT 0% reverse charge) — a report with per-invoice jurisdictional breakdown and the invoice-level tax reason to pass to our tax team.

I attached a small CSV export from our side with the days where the spike aligns. This is blocking our AP team; they placed a partial hold on payment until we reconcile.

Thanks,
Priya
Priya Sharma
Head of Finance, Cobalt AI
priya@cobaltai.com
From: laura.bennett@redwood.com

Date: Tue, 12 Jan 2027 10:03:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Invoice 2026-12 — unexpected reranker/embed charges and VAT reverse-charge evidence

Hi Priya — thanks for flagging and for the CSV. I'm sorry for the payment friction.

Quick summary of next steps from our side:
- I'm looping in Ben (billing ops) and Markus (tax) to validate the token attribution and provide the per-jurisdiction export you requested.
- Ben — can you pull our per-request attribution logs for Cobalt for the date range 2026-12-01 -> 2026-12-31 and check for duplicate embed attributions where a single incoming request spawned an auxiliary model call? If possible, include request IDs, model names, and token counts.
- Markus — can you prepare the reverse-charge packet we provide EU customers (invoice-level reason, tax IDs, and the export format Cobalt needs)?

I'll come back with an ETA by EOD tomorrow. If you'd like a quick call while we dig in let me know.

Best,
Laura

Senior Manager, Customer Billing & Reconciliation
Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood.com
From: ben.carter@redwood.com
To: laura.bennett@redwood.com, markus.klein@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 12 Jan 2027 12:18:00 +0000
Subject: Internal: Cobalt embed attribution check (logs requested)

Laura / Markus — I pulled a sampled export for the date range and the pattern is consistent with an auxiliary embed call being billed independently. Notes from a quick review:
- Sampled request ids show a top-level "chat"/generation call (model:gpt-large) that invoked a reranker pipeline which called model:embed-lite as an auxiliary step. Our metering pipeline currently attributes tokens at the model-level per invocation; that means embed-lite invocations are billed as embed units even if they were internal to a larger request flow.
- The count delta matches Cobalt's CSV rows on 2026-12-08 and 2026-12-09 (two high-volume jobs).

Action items:
1) Recommend an immediate one-off customer credit for the documented duplicate-attribution for December while we propose a longer-term fix (billing attribution rule to mark auxiliary embed calls as nested and bill parent-only).
2) I can generate the per-request export with request_id, parent_request_id (if available), model, token_type (embed/generation), token_count, and the jurisdiction tag. That should cover both reconciliation and VAT mapping.

Estimate: I can produce the export by tomorrow mid-day. For the credit amount I estimate ~€24,600 (pre-tax) on the sampled delta — I'll convert to final after full export.

-ben
Ben Carter
Billing Operations
ben.carter@redwood.com
From: laura.bennett@redwood.com
To: Priya Sharma <priya@cobaltai.com>
Cc: ben.carter@redwood.com, markus.klein@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 13 Jan 2027 15:42:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Invoice 2026-12 — provisional credit & VAT documentation (next steps)

Hi Priya — quick update and proposed resolution: 

Summary:
- Ben confirmed an attribution pattern that caused auxiliary embed invocations to be billed separately. We will treat this as a metering attribution issue and have prepared a provisional credit while we finalize the numbers.

What we're sending now (attached / links):
- Provisional credit note: credit_note_9842.pdf (attached) — covers the preliminary duplicate-attribution delta for December. Amount is shown pre-tax; final VAT treatment will follow after you confirm jurisdiction and reverse-charge eligibility.
- Per-request export: public link (sensitive) — https://internal.redwood.com/exports/DEAL-9842-202612-export.csv (redacted for external copy; full file attached to the HubSpot record). This export contains: request_id, parent_request_id, model, token_category, token_count, timestamp, and billing_jurisdiction.
- VAT packet: Markus attached a short note on reverse-charge evidence required for EU AP teams. He also included Redwood's tax id and the legal reason code we place on export files.

Next steps for you:
- Please review the provisional credit and confirm whether Cobalt will accept the credit as a solution to release the payment hold. If accepted, we'll finalize the credit and issue a signed credit note.
- For VAT: please confirm the country / VAT ID you want us to reference for reverse-charge so Markus can finalize the packet and stamp the credit accordingly.

I appreciate your patience; we do not expect this pattern to recur after we deploy the attribution rule change.

Links & attachments:
- DocuSign credit link: https://www.docusign.com/link/abc123-creditnote
- Attachment: credit_note_9842.pdf

Thanks,
Laura

Cobalt accepts the provisional credit; Hans (cc'd) will confirm the VAT ID for reverse-charge (DE 123456789). We'll sign the credit note via DocuSign as requested. Attached is our signed PO for the adjustment: signed_po_9842.pdf.

I'll sign the DocuSign today. Once the credit is finalized and the reverse-charge packet is issued we'll release payment.

Best,
Priya
